name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 5
summary:
The February update for Monster Hunter Wilds arrives on Wednesday, 18 February, 2026! Take on imposing new challenges with Arch-Tempered Arkveld, 10-star Arch Tempered Monsters, and unique new Event Quests!

The update also adds a collaboration event with Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, the weapon and pendant designs from the Design Contest, and an event celebrating the 1st anniversary.
